best_idea: Show a status chip only while its value is past a threshold, in a fixed order, colour-coded good or bad, and rebuild the strip only when a watched value changes.
decision_why: Keep the threshold rule, the fixed order and the good or bad flag; drop the 130 px chain (five chips need 635 px and do not fit a 375 px phone) in favour of a wrapping row; make the thresholds and the chip list data.
acceptance: At 375 px wide, a character with poison and radiation shows both chips in a wrapped row with no horizontal scroll; the POISONED chip is absent at poison 0 and present at poison 1; the RADIATED chip is absent at 65 and present at 66; chips always appear in the order ADDICT, SNEAK, LEVEL, POISONED, RADIATED.
